title: Juniper and the Spire
author: Y. M. Amberdale
blurb: August Thornbury, a debt-bound temple scribe, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
